notice.token: The session expired or the token is missing. Run `uno` again in your terminal and open the address it prints.
notice.offline: No connection to the local server. Run `uno` again in your terminal.
chat.title: Orchestrator
chat.placeholder: What do you want done in this project… (Enter sends)
chat.empty.ready: Tell the orchestrator what you want. It proposes a plan of role steps; you approve it under “Review & approval” and nothing reaches your branch until you merge.
chat.iters.hint: reviewers' medium/high findings go back to the developer at most this many times; then the orchestrator asks you
state.question: the orchestrator has a question
agents.title: Live agents
review.title: Review & approval
review.result.hint: Consolidated diff of the integration branch. Merge puts it on your branch; nothing happens without this click.
review.merge: Approve and merge into my branch
review.confirm.approve: Approve the plan and run {n} steps?
review.confirm.merge: Merge {branch} into your branch? Review the diff and the findings first.
err.main: The branch is {branch}: Uno does not work on it.
err.dirty: The repository has uncommitted changes: commit or stash them, then choose it again.
err.untrusted: The roles changed outside Uno: review and confirm them before running.
err.noroles: This project has no roles: run `uno init` in its folder, then choose it again.
branch.confirm: Create and check out branch {name} in {repo}?
adv.title: Advanced
adv.newrun.hint: Independent tasks, one agent each. paths: one or more globs, space-separated (required). Agents never commit; the orchestrator does.
adv.roles.hint: Stored in .uno/ of the repository (agents can read it, never change it). Roles must be committed before a run.
adv.commit.confirm: Commit .uno/ (roles and project context) on the current branch?
adv.trust: These roles and this project context were not created from this UI, or changed since you confirmed them. Their instructions reach the model. Review them (select each role), then confirm. Runs on this repository are blocked until you do.
adv.r.name: name
adv.project.placeholder: What this project is, its conventions, what reviewers should care about.
adv.results.hint: Review every diff before you ship it. The gate limits where an agent can write, not what it writes.
adv.results.manual: Not merged. There is no merge button for this by design: review the diff, then merge by hand if it is right.
adv.publish.hint: The UI never pushes or runs gh: paste this in your terminal.
adv.t.name: name
adv.steering: the repository contains agent instruction files that may reach the model: {files}
roles.title: Project roles
roles.hint: A role is what an agent is, what it may do and where. Roles live in the repository's .uno/; what you change here is confirmed. Protected paths apply to every role.
roles.name: name
roles.folders: which folders it works in (space-separated globs)
roles.copyName: A role with that name exists. Name for the copy:
roles.noproject: Choose a project before managing its roles.
